terms.definition: the managed-repository factory resource and policy boundary represented in the graph
an authorization and isolation boundary for principals, repositories, resources, policy, and cost; the current deployment has one configured default scope
the canonical managed repository identity independent of provider locator, checkout, branch, or worktree
the product label for exactly one conceptual repository scope until a later accepted ADR defines a multi-repository Project resource
a graph-owned unit of proposed or adopted work with exact dependencies, eligibility, and policy context
one immutable execution attempt for a task under an exact lease and fencing token; retries create new attempts
a bounded purpose and audience-specific interaction resource linked to an attempt; it is not a browser session or provider thread
a content-addressed proposed change reconstructed by the controller and awaiting independent evidence and disposition
an immutable complete repository-wiki compilation whose activation is a separate governed decision
a noncurrent audience-scoped rendering or candidate wiki edition bound to exact source, attempt, candidate, session, and fence
terms.authority_owner: source projection plus current graph authorization

terms.definition: signed authentication material for one browser context; it conveys no durable product truth and must be reauthorized
terms.authority_owner: identity provider and server session policy

terms.definition: one browser navigation/DOM context; a tab identifier is never a durable session, scope, lease, or authority token
a provider-owned conversation or run reference observed as external evidence; it is not an InteractionSession
an exact host-controlled or delegated execution class/profile that runs an attempt but cannot accept its own result
an OS or BEAM process instance; process identity is diagnostic and never required for durable recovery
a cataloged coding or maintainer capability/profile presented independently of its disposable runtime process
a complete authorized server-rendered document for one durable route and navigation context
a bounded independently authorized HEEx subtree returned for one declared page region
an authorized bounded presentation value with source, revisions, freshness, completeness, truncation, warnings, and provenance
a bounded browser value used to request rendering or an admitted command; it never grants authority
an authorized expiring delivery channel for projections or hints with bounded queues and reauthorization
terms.authority_owner: server authorization at connection and delivery time

terms.definition: a lossy notification that tells a consumer to re-query; it is not an event store or truth
either a presentation fragment patch or a content-addressed candidate source patch; callers must qualify which and neither is accepted truth by itself
terms.authority_owner: fragment projection or candidate artifact contract

terms.definition: a versioned governed semantic intent with exact actor, scope, preconditions, revisions, idempotency, and authorization
a filesystem, provider, model, tool, credential, publication, or other operation performed only after durable invocation and current-fence authorization
an immutable bounded graph record of a command outcome, revisions, identity, counts, and recovery semantics
an attributable observation or verification result about an exact source, candidate, effect, or outcome; evidence does not decide acceptance
a policy-authorized disposition of claims or control state at exact evidence and graph revisions
terms.authority_owner: authorized decision actor through semantic command

terms.definition: the declared time/revision relationship between a projection and its authoritative inputs
a bounded honest state describing whether an exact capability is composed and safe to use; module existence is insufficient
the final-goal outcome recorded only by a sufficient policy-authorized decision after external application and post-change verification

qualified_language_rules.rule: must be qualified as browser_session, interaction_session, or provider_thread in normative target contracts
means the presentation alias for one conceptual_repository; do not mint a separate durable Project resource
must be qualified as presentation fragment patch or candidate source patch
name the semantic profile separately from runtime and process
qualify runtime completion, task disposition, external application, post-change verification, or final-goal satisfaction
include the revision, source, scope, and validity boundary that makes the claim current
